title: Investigation of Central and Systemic Immune Mechanisms in the Brain and Peripheral Tissues following Ischemic Stroke
summary: An ischemic stroke induces phenotypic immune signatures that differ between the central nervous system and peripheral organs.  As part of this project, brain tissue and peripheral immune organs are being systematically examined with the aim of more closely characterizing stroke-specific central-systemic immune responses.
conditions: Cerebral infarction due to thrombosis of precerebral arteries

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Deceased adults (>18 years) with ischemic stroke, other neurodegenerative diseases, and controls from a biobank
Exclusion criteria:
•  Severe decomposition/autolysis, rendering the tissue unsuitable for histological/molecular analysis
•    Legal restrictions that prevent the tissue from being used for research
•    Cases in which consent was not obtained prior to the patient’s death or from a representative or family member
